decision.explanation: The question asks specifically about when "Attorney General Lawrence" served in his position. From the provided sources, there are two distinct individuals named James Lawrence who served as Ohio Attorney General: one from 1884–1886 and another from 1900–1902. These are both valid answers because they refer to different individuals with the same name serving in the same position at different times. Other candidates (1792 and 1971) refer to different individuals (Nathaniel Lawrence and Bert Lawrence), so they are not relevant to the question as phrased.
